sloka: वृक्षेण आवार्य यदि माम् सीते हसितुम् इच्छसि ।अलम् ते हसितेन अद्य माम् भजस्व सुदुःखितम् ॥३-६१-४॥
transliteration: vṛkṣeṇa āvārya yadi mām sīte hasitum icchasi ।alam te hasitena adya mām bhajasva suduḥkhitam ॥3-61-4॥

translations.english: O Sita if you intend to make fun by hiding behind a tree, I tell you it is enough. Stop it and come to this extremely sorrowful man.
